corpus.batch_policy: each split is an independent resumable publication batch
corpus.fallback_reporting: Main-40 is the predeclared minimum confirmatory ablation; completed Extension-50 and Validation-20 batches expand the analysis without changing Main-40 outcomes

retrieval.note: Confirmatory conditions use frozen candidate-set inputs; retrieval is not rerun.

m4_repair_controller.repair_budget_scope: all repair completions, including parse-seed repairs
m4_repair_controller.candidate_selection: lexicographic public-gate rank: overall pass, consecutive passed prefix G0..G6, total passed gates, fewer diagnostics
m4_repair_controller.diagnostic_memory: up to 60 unique public diagnostics across prior states
m4_repair_controller.regressions: audited but never replace a better candidate

ablation.reference_condition: full M4 from the frozen v21 primary batch

condition_definitions.a1_no_contracts: withhold contract context and contract details; expose only failed gate identities during repair
condition_definitions.a2_no_policies: withhold lifecycle/policy context; expose only failed gate identities during repair
condition_definitions.a3_no_g5_repair_feedback: retain G5 validation and final scoring but redact G5 diagnostic codes, messages, and paths from repair prompts
condition_definitions.a5_no_repair: M3 pre-repair pipeline with the same visible inputs and no diagnostic repair
condition_definitions.a6_unstructured_diagnostics: retain M4 repair opportunities but expose only failed gate identities for every actionable gate

stage_removal_sensitivity.contrast: v21 M2 catalog-grounded direct Argo versus v21 full M4
stage_removal_sensitivity.interpretation: bundled removal of ServiceFlowIR assembly, deterministic projection, IR validation, and IR-local repair; not an IR-only causal effect

held_constant: repair budget except for the declared no-repair condition

analysis.repetition_aggregation: aggregate three repetitions within each instance before inference
analysis.multiplicity: Holm correction across five confirmatory contrasts

scoring.empty_wiring_policy: not_applicable when both gold and submission have no producer-consumer pairs

design.formula: 110 instances x 1 model x 5 confirmatory conditions x 3 seeds
design.primary_unit: condition x split x instance x seed

notes: V24 supersedes v23 after its one-instance pilot showed that direct-Argo M2 does not define G3, G4, G6, or an end-to-end full-pass outcome comparable with M4.
The v23 pilot and freeze remain immutable audit artifacts and are excluded from publication inference.
This freeze is independent of and does not mutate the completed v21 primary batch.
Main-40 is run first, Extension-50 second, and Validation-20 last.
Stopping after Main-40 because of a pre-existing deadline is permitted, but the paper must report that scope and must not pool partially completed later strata.
Infrastructure failures remain pending cells and are retried only by resuming the same immutable batch summary.
No condition may be added, removed, or redefined after inspecting confirmatory v24 outcomes.
